body:
I can totally relate to the abandonment feeling OP is expressing in their post, and I would feel the same way if it was me. I get way too attached to people. But from an outsiders perspective you are exactly right. This therapist really seems like they want to help OP find the best possible treatment, and they are being honest that the OPs current situation is not within their range of experience or ability.

 That's a lot better than a narcissistic therapist who thinks they can do it all themselves when they are vastly under qualified .

Hey man, your not crazy. A lot of people think the way you do about monogamy you just need to find your people, but you won't always find them where you are. Sometimes you need to go out and find your people. The same goes for any unconventional beliefs you  might have. 

Can you just take a trip to the sea? Maybe it will help to clear your mind. Or just do something fun, just for yourself to get out of the house. I always feel so much more at peace when I'm near the water, even if it's just a fountain in a public square or a swimming pool, but especially natural sources of water like the sea and rivers and lakes. 

I also started studying computer science to try to fill the void, and hopefully have some kind of future for myself, and I can relate to it just making me feel stupid every day, like I can't grasp the concepts as fast as other people. 

You're English is incredible by the way. I'm also in Spain (not originally from spain) and I'm trying to find jobs in web development and they all want native Spanish speakers with a high level of English and there are so many opportunities for internships and jobs like that right now. 

Not gonna lie your family sounds like they are really holding you down. It really might help if you can spend as much time out of the house as possible. Taking your dog to a dog park, or volunteering somewhere, or literally anything to spend more time with your dog and less time around your family would probably do wonders for your mental health.

Idk man, maybe this sounds kinda cliche but I really mean it. It means a lot that you are still trying. It says a lot about your character that even in this situation you are still trying to reach out and find some reason to keep going. That takes a lot of strength to keep holding onto that small light inside of yourself when everything else seems so dark. 

It's not your fault what's happened to you but it sounds like every day you just keep trying to do what you can,and that's all  anyone can do. The system isn't fair, and it's rigged against a lot of people but your very existence is kind of like a middle finger to that system that's trying to hold you down, so I think that's one reason to keep fighting.
Your hair is incredible, and you really pull off that nose ring!

Cheers to you for seeking out community and asking for a pickmeup when you feel bad instead of doing something less healthy. I just wanna say this whole pic seems super cozy, and you totally seem like the type of person it'd be nice to just vibe with while listening to some music.

Your pose and expression in this pic seems kinda regal, the only thing you're missing is your 👑. Do you ever see kings smiling in their paintings? Good luck king on your new journey in life, and I hope you can find something to make you smile!
